github.description: sofagent is an open-source FDE Harness for AI coding agents — on entry, write your business judgment into files (workflows, ontology, AI nodes); after departure, audit every change against them. 25 codified audit rules, tamper-evident chain, snapshots, and an MCP toolset (104 tools, 11 plugins). Everything can be FDEing.
